Scaled dot product

Source: R/lax_extra.R
lax_scaled_dot.Rd

Port of jax.lax.scaled_dot: (lhs * lhs_scale) %*% (rhs * rhs_scale) computed in bfloat16 with preferred_element_type accumulation (default bfloat16). Each scale has the shape of its operand except along the contracting dimensions, where the operand size must be a multiple (at least 2) of the scale size. Missing scales are ones (JAX uses float8_e8m0fnu ones, a dtype jaxR does not have; the values are equal). Not differentiable, as in JAX.

Usage

lax_scaled_dot(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  lhs_scale = NULL,
  rhs_scale = NULL,
  dimension_numbers = NULL,
  preferred_element_type = NULL
)

Arguments

lhs, rhs

Arrays.

lhs_scale, rhs_scale

Optional scale arrays.

dimension_numbers

Dot dimension numbers; by default the last dimension of lhs is contracted with the second to last of rhs and the leading dimensions are batch dimensions.

preferred_element_type

Result dtype ("bfloat16" or "float32").

Value

An array.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lax_scaled_dot(matrix(1, 2, 4), matrix(1, 4, 3), preferred_element_type = "float32")
} # }
